# Java functional programming — immutable objects, streams, Optionals

Curated by Skill Harbor — @jabrena's Java functional-programming skill (part of the Plinth Toolkit, by Juan Antonio Breña Moral): apply functional principles to Java to improve immutability, expressiveness and maintainability. Covers immutable objects and Records (JEP 395), pure side-effect-free functions, functional interfaces, lambdas and method references, Stream API pipelines (filter/map/reduce, parallel streams, unmodifiable collectors), idiomatic `Optional` (`map`/`flatMap`/`filter`/`orElse*` over `isPresent()`+`get()`), function composition (`andThen`/`compose`), higher-order functions (memoization, currying, partial application), pattern matching for `instanceof` and `switch` (Java 21), sealed classes/interfaces, switch expressions, Stream Gatherers (JEP 461), and effect-boundary separation (side effects at the edges, pure core) — each area with good/bad code examples in `references/142-java-functional-programming.md`. Its signature is hard safety gates: run `./mvnw compile` before refactoring, stop immediately on a red build, verify the maven-compiler-plugin supports the features, run `./mvnw clean verify` after, and ask when scope is ambiguous. Honest caveats: methodology only — the agent needs a compiling Java project (Maven) to apply it to; Apache-2.0 licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
